notes: INSIDE half of the Gauntling Scrap Shotgun: a junk hopper full of bolts and scrap above a gear train, a feed chute to the right (the ammo rack sits beside it), power coupling, patched hatch and five copper coils. damaged: a gear cracked and stuttering, bits spilling; disabled: the gear train jammed, the chute split. Barrel layer gauntling_scrap_shotgun_barrel: two sawn-off pipes of different widths (one steel, one rust) clamped with wire and hazard tape; fire: a spray of scrap pellets from both muzzles.
